description: This file contains functions and logic for performing memory health checks, audits, and repairs within the 'openclaw' project. It includes imports from various modules, functions for resolving memory providers, checking configurations, and generating diagnostic notes related to memory search health and artifacts.

methods.name: resolveSuggestedRemoteMemoryProvider
methods.description: Finds and returns the provider ID of a remote memory provider from the list of auto-select metadata.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if possible, or returns null.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeMemoryAuditContext
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current memory audit context including workspace directory, backend, database path, and QMD collections.

methods.name: buildMemoryRecallIssueNote
methods.description: Generates a note string summarizing issues found in a memory audit, including fix or verify guidance.

methods.name: noteMemoryRecallHealth
methods.description: Performs a memory recall health check and posts a note if issues are found.

methods.name: maybeRepairMemoryRecallHealth
methods.description: Checks for fixable memory issues and prompts for repair, then posts a note about the repair process.

methods.name: noteMemorySearchHealth
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive health check of the memory search configuration and provider readiness, posting notes with findings.

methods.name: hasLocalEmbeddings
methods.description: Determines if local embeddings are available based on model path and fallback options.

methods.name: hasApiKeyForProvider
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if an API key is configured for a given provider.

methods.name: resolvePrimaryMemoryProviderEnvVar
methods.description: Resolves the environment variable name for the primary memory provider's API key.

methods.name: formatMemoryProviderEnvVarList
methods.description: Formats a list of environment variable names for multiple providers into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: buildGatewayProbeWarning
methods.description: Creates a warning message if the gateway memory probe is not ready.
